how_to_apply: Prepare a detailed Bio-data and a statement of purpose (SOP).
Collect copies of educational qualifications and other relevant documents.
Send the complete application package via email to the Principal Investigator, Dr. Khushubo Devi, at [email protected].
Ensure the application reaches the email address on or before 30 October 2026, 5:00 PM.
important_instructions: The appointment is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project. Maximum tenure of the project is 36 months or till the end of the project, whichever is earlier. Mere possession of minimum qualifications does not guarantee an invitation to the interview. Only shortlisted candidates will be informed of the interview date by email. The Google Meet link will be shared only with the shortlisted candidates before the interview date. Selected candidates will be encouraged to join the Ph.D. program at IIT Indore. Candidates completing their M. Tech. in the current academic year are also encouraged to apply.

faq.question: Q1. What is the recruitment position advertised by IIT Indore?
faq.answer: IIT Indore has advertised for 1 Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position under the Department of Metallurgical Engineering and Materials Science (MEMS).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for IIT Indore JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications via email is 30 October 2026, up to 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for IIT Indore JRF?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold an M.Tech. or M.E. in relevant engineering branches with a first division, or a Post Graduate degree in Physics, Chemistry, or Materials Science with a first division along with a valid NET or GATE certificate.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for IIT Indore JRF applicants?
faq.answer: The preferred age limit is 29 years, with relaxations of 5 years for SC/ST candidates and 3 years for OBC candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What is the fellowship amount offered for this JRF position?
faq.answer: The consolidated fellowship is Rs. 37,000/- per month, which increases to Rs. 42,000/- per month for the third year.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for the IIT Indore JRF post?
faq.answer: Interested candidates must send their detailed bio-data, statement of purpose, and qualification documents to the Principal Investigator at [email protected].

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q8. Can selected candidates pursue a Ph.D. at IIT Indore?
faq.answer: Yes, the selected candidate will be encouraged to join the Ph.D. program at IIT Indore.
